title: 3 hours is the norm for piano + ambience
detail: Cozy Timez 3 h videos have 7.9M and 8.6M views; SnowWhisper Sleep 3 h got 190K in 2 months. Pure sound and purring go 8, 12 or 24 h. Our 98 min is short for the niche.

title: Purring is its own big sub-niche
detail: HomeMe 'Cozy Purring Cat ASMR' 24 h has 3.2M views; Catnap Melodies (35K subs) 3 h cat video 198K. We have no purr layer yet.

title: Dog side is open and big
detail: Rainy Guy 8 h sleeping-dog fireplace videos reach 1M to 4.2M views; Heal Dogs 8 h 548K. Few cozy dog channels compete, so a dog video is a good second test.

title: Small channels can still break in
detail: Cozy Little Studio got 41.8K views in one month on a 1 h cabin video; SnowWhisper Sleep (3.7K subs) 190K in 2 months. New uploads in the niche are 2 hours to 1 month old: demand is live.

title: Titles are keyword strings
detail: Scene + sounds + use + length, with ❄️🔥🐾. Recurring words: cozy (winter) cabin, sleeping cat, crackling fireplace, falling snow, soft piano, deep sleep, relaxing, ambience, 3 hours. '4K' is rare in this niche (0 of 15 top cat/cabin titles); YouTube shows its own 4K badge.

title: Thumbnails have no text
detail: Dark full room, glowing fire and a snowy or rainy window, the animal small. Descriptions open with a 2-3 line scene story, then uses (sleep, study, reading), then hashtags. Categories: Music, Entertainment, People & Blogs (none use Pets & Animals).

title: Publish time matters less than full 4K processing
detail: Top videos went live at all hours (00:00-23:33 IST). The biggest (Cozy Timez 7.9M) went live Fri 7 pm US Eastern. Long sleep videos live on search and suggested traffic for years; be fully processed before the first US evening.

title: Video 2 plan
